tenderSchedule.title: Construction of Skywalk-PPP Modal Santhosh theatre
tenderSchedule.description: Construction of Skywalk under PPP Model on Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer (DBFOT) based on Dynamic Duration model under Commercial Advertisement rights at Santhosh Theatre on Kempe Gowda Road.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Successful experience in operation and maintenance of similar projects which are in existence either directly or through sub-contracting for a period of at least one year

The Bidder (in case of single entity) or the consortium together should have Minimum Net worth of Rs 250.00 Lakhs for reserved category at the end of the latest financial year. Individual Member if applying should have a minimum Annual turnover of Rs 100. Lakhs in last five years For reserved category

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder (in case of single entity) or the members of consortium as the case should be profit-making organization/s for 2 years out of the last 5 years.
